shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

notes: Taḥwīl «ح» after «عن ابن، شهاب» : the two branches share the tail written once after their last names: Sa'id bin al-Musayyab and Abu Salama, then the Companion Abdullah bin Amr, who relays the saying («أن عبد الله بن عمرو ... قال»).
The comma in «ابن، شهاب» is in the text and kept as written.
